holdout.rule: strict: the test split of the curated plaque dataset of 2026-10-15 (einarolafsson/toxoplasma-plaque-curated-2026-10-15, revision 91d4f1cd), grouped by source paper or plate; never used for training or checkpoint selection

scores.pooling: micro-average over all test fields: object F1, precision and recall from summed TP/FP/FN (optimal one-to-one matching, IoU >= 0.5, as spacr.scorecard.match_objects); AJI = sum C / sum U (Kumar 2017); Dice = 2 sum |T and P| / sum (|T| + |P|) over foreground pixels; boundary F1 from summed boundary-pixel hits at 2 px tolerance (spacr.scorecard._boundary). Segmentation through spacr.plaque.segment_plaque_image with diameter 30, flow threshold 0.4, cell probability 0.
